lines: Aye jazba-e-dil gar main chahoon
couplets.en: O yearning of my heart, if I so wish.

lines: Har cheez muqabil aa jaaye
Manzil ke liye do gaam chaloon aur saamne manzil aa jaaye
couplets.en: Let all things come before me, and let the destination appear when I take two steps toward it.

lines: Aye jazba-e-dil gar main chahoon
couplets.en: O yearning of my heart, if I so wish.

lines: Aye dil ki khalish chal yun hi sahi, chalta to hoon unki mehfil mein
couplets.en: Come then, ache of my heart, I am going to their gathering all the same.

lines: Aye dil ki khalish chal yun hi sahi, chalta to hoon unki mehfil mein
Us waqt mujhe chaunka dena, jab rang pe mehfil aa jaaye
couplets.en: Come then, ache of my heart, and startle me when their gathering comes alive.

lines: Us waqt mujhe chaunka dena, jab rang pe mehfil aa jaaye
couplets.en: Startle me just as the gathering comes alive.

lines: Aye jazba-e-dil gar main chahoon
couplets.en: O yearning of my heart, if I so wish.

lines: Aye rahbar-e-kaamil chalne ko tayyar to hoon par yaad rahe
couplets.en: O trusty guide, I am ready to set out, but remember this.

lines: Us waqt mujhe bhatka dena, jab saamne manzil aa jaaye
couplets.en: Lead me astray just as the destination comes into view.

lines: Us waqt mujhe bhatka dena, jab saamne manzil aa jaaye

lines: Aye jazba-e-dil gar main chahoon
couplets.en: O yearning of my heart, if I so wish.

lines: Aawaaz mujhe tum de lena
couplets.en: Call out to me.

lines: Aawaaz mujhe tum de lena
Is raah-e-mohabbat mein koi darpesh jo mushkil aa jaaye
couplets.en: Call out to me if trouble meets you on the path of love.

lines: Is raah-e-mohabbat mein koi darpesh jo mushkil aa jaaye
couplets.en: If trouble meets you on the path of love.

lines: Aye jazba-e-dil gar main chahoon
couplets.en: O yearning of my heart, if I so wish.

lines: Ab kyun dhoondhoon woh chashm-e-karam, hone de sitam baala-e-sitam
couplets.en: Why seek a kindly glance now, when one cruelty may follow another?

lines: Ab kyun dhoondhoon woh chashm-e-karam, hone de sitam baala-e-sitam
Main chahta hoon aye jazba-e-gham, mushkil pas-e-mushkil aa jaaye
couplets.en: Why seek a kindly glance now, O longing for sorrow, when I wish for one trial after another?

lines: Main chahta hoon aye jazba-e-gham, mushkil pas-e-mushkil aa jaaye
couplets.en: O longing for sorrow, I wish for one trial after another.
